body: Absorbed into the v1.69.0.0 wave (#2666) with your authorship preserved and CHANGELOG credit. Independent review verified the mechanism (bug-bash thread + an unrelated project hitting the same class) and audited all 11 guarded scripts for pre-bash-5 syntax. Wave adaptation: the pipe-probe test skips on minimal-/dev sandboxes; the bash-4.3/4.4 BASH_COMPAT warning caveat is documented in the commit body. Thank you!
